novel_policies.label: houses oversight in a joint
novel_policies.quote: There is created the Medical Licensure Commission composed of seven physicians, each of whom shall be either a doctor of medicine or a doctor of osteopathy and be licensed to practice medicine or osteopathy in this state.

novel_policies.label: does not require pain management education
administrative medicine license available
novel_policies.quote: An administrative medicine license does not convey the authority to practice clinical medicine, examine, care for, or treat patients, prescribe medications including controlled substances, or delegate medical acts or prescriptive authority to others.

novel_policies.label: controlled substance database registration required
novel_policies.quote: Require that a licensee who has a federal Drug Enforcement Administration registration number register with the controlled substance prescription database.

novel_policies.label: hospital privilege action reporting required
novel_policies.quote: A hospital that revokes, suspends, conditions, restricts, or refuses to grant hospital privileges to, or imposes a consultation requirement on, a person licensed to practice medicine or osteopathy in the state shall report to the board the name and address of the person and the reasons for the action within seven working days after the action is taken.

novel_policies.label: investigational drug protection
novel_policies.quote: A physician may not be subject to disciplinary action by the board for prescribing, dispensing, or administering an investigational drug, biological product, or device, or providing related treatment, to a patient for the purpose of sustaining the patient's life if the patient has a terminal illness and is ineligible or unable to participate in a current clinical trial.

novel_policies.label: has advisory board
novel_policies.quote: There shall be within the Department of Public Health a Connecticut Medical Examining Board.

novel_policies.label: houses oversight in a division
novel_policies.quote: There shall be a board of medicine consisting of 11 members

novel_policies.label: locum tenens permit available
novel_policies.quote: A member of the board, its executive secretary, or a person designated by the board to issue temporary permits may grant a temporary permit to a physician or osteopath for the purpose of substituting for another physician or osteopath licensed in this state.

novel_policies.label: max physician assistants per supervising physician
novel_policies.quote: A delegating physician may not enter into a nurse protocol agreement pursuant to this Code section or enter into a job description with a physician assistant pursuant to Code Section 43-34-103 with more than the combined equivalent of eight advanced practice registered nurses or physician assistants at any one time.

novel_policies.label: opioid prescribing limits
novel_policies.quote: A licensee may not issue an initial prescription for an opioid that exceeds a seven-day supply to an adult patient for outpatient use.

novel_policies.label: pain management clinic registration required
novel_policies.quote: All physicians providing pain management services shall obtain a pain management registration from the board.

novel_policies.label: pain management education required
novel_policies.quote: Receive education in pain management and opioid use and addiction, unless the applicant has demonstrated to the satisfaction of the board that the applicant does not currently hold a valid federal Drug Enforcement Administration registration number.

novel_policies.label: sexual misconduct training required
novel_policies.quote: On and after January 1, 2022, all physicians shall be required to receive one-time education and training, for a minimum of two hours, regarding professional boundaries and physician sexual misconduct.

novel_policies.label: telemedicine license available
novel_policies.quote: The board shall be authorized to issue telemedicine licenses to physicians who are licensed in other states but not licensed in this state to engage in the practice of medicine through telemedicine.

novel_policies.label: foreign medical graduate requirements
novel_policies.quote: Applicants who are graduates of medical colleges not accredited by the Association of American Medical Colleges and the Council on Medical Education of the American Medical Association shall have successfully completed three years of postgraduate training.

novel_policies.label: impaired physician program authorized
novel_policies.quote: Under regulations adopted by the board, contract with private professional organizations to establish an impaired medical professionals program to identify, confront, evaluate, and treat persons licensed under this chapter who abuse alcohol, other drugs, or other substances or are mentally ill or cognitively impaired.

novel_policies.label: interstate medical licensure compact member
novel_policies.quote: The Interstate Medical Licensure Compact is hereby enacted into law and entered into with all other jurisdictions legally joining therein.

novel_policies.label: school approval basis: unspecified
novel_policies.quote: from a legally chartered medical school in the United States or commonwealth of Puerto Rico or Canada having the power to confer degrees in medicine

novel_policies.label: experience source: none
novel_policies.quote: Present to the board a valid diploma from a medical college in good standing with the board or have been actively engaged in the practice of medicine, in a manner determined by the board to have been satisfactory, for not less than four years under a temporary permit issued pursuant to R.S. 37:1275

novel_policies.label: does not require post degree experience
novel_policies.quote: Present to the board a valid diploma from a medical college in good standing with the board or have been actively engaged in the practice of medicine, in a manner determined by the board to have been satisfactory, for not less than four years under a temporary permit issued pursuant to R.S. 37:1275

novel_policies.label: houses oversight in a department
novel_policies.quote: There shall be within the Department of Public Health a Connecticut Medical Examining Board.

novel_policies.label: malpractice reporting required
novel_policies.quote: A person licensed under this chapter shall report in writing to the board concerning the outcome of each medical malpractice claim or civil action in which damages have been or are to be paid by or on behalf of the licensee to the claimant or plaintiff, whether by judgment or under a settlement.

novel_policies.label: physician assistant supervision model: job description with board approval
novel_policies.quote: PHYSICIAN SUPERVISION. A formal relationship between a licensed assistant to a physician and a licensed physician under which the assistant to the physician is authorized to practice as evidenced by a written job description approved in accordance with this article.

novel_policies.label: telehealth prescribing rules
novel_policies.quote: A prescription for a controlled substance may only be issued as a result of telehealth medical services if the telehealth visit includes synchronous audio or audio-visual communication using HIPAA compliant equipment with the prescriber responsible for the prescription and the prescriber has had at least one in-person encounter with the patient within the preceding 12 months.

novel_policies.label: physician assistant prescriptive authority
novel_policies.quote: A physician may delegate to a physician assistant, in accordance with a job description, the authority to issue a prescription drug order or orders for any dangerous drug or any Schedule III, IV, or V controlled substance. Nothing in this Code section shall be construed to authorize the written prescription drug order of a Schedule I or II controlled substance.

novel_policies.label: physician assistant supervision model
novel_policies.quote: A physician assistant shall collaborate with, consult with, or refer to the appropriate member of the facility health care team as indicated by the condition of the patient; the education, experience, and competence of the physician assistant; and the community standard of care.

novel_policies.label: postgraduate training years required
novel_policies.quote: Satisfactory evidence that the applicant has successfully completed one year of postgraduate internship or resident training in a hospital approved for such training by the board.

novel_policies.label: compelled mental physical exam authority
novel_policies.quote: The board may, upon probable cause, compel a physician to submit to a mental or physical examination by designated physicians or to submit to alcohol or drug screening within a time specified by the board.

novel_policies.label: license status types
novel_policies.quote: On retiring from practice and payment of an appropriate one-time fee, a licensee in good standing with the board may apply for the conversion of an active or inactive license to a retired status license.

novel_policies.label: houses oversight in a shared board
novel_policies.quote: the governor shall appoint a Hawaii medical board whose duty it shall be to examine all applicants for license to practice medicine or surgery. As used in this chapter, "board" means the Hawaii medical board.
